{{Quote|I fell in love with a Mandalorian girl, married into the clans, and a ''hut'uun'' killed her. I know his name. I'll find him. And then I'll show him what it means to make a bad enemy of a Mandalorian with anatomical expertise and a scalpel.|Mij Gilamar, explaining his gold armor to Bardan Jusik|<ref name="Order66" />}}
'''Tani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior and the wife of [[Mij Gilamar]]. Tani met Gilamar while he was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], and the two fell in love. At some point later, they were [[Marriage/Legends|married]], and Gilamar was adopted into the clans, becoming a Mandalorian. Unfortunately for them both, their happiness together would not last, as Tani was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] sometime before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Order66" /> Gilamar took Tani's death hard, initially drowning his pain in his continuing work as a doctor,<ref name="Imperial Commando">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> and painting his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] in the traditional sand-[[Gold/Legends|gold]] coloring that signified a quest for revenge in the Mandalorian culture, swearing that one day he would find Tani's killer and return the favor in kind.<ref name="Order66" />
